summary: Estimation loss per opportunity = CRPS(shifted S0 empirical distribution, y) / sigma_M0 (standard empirical CRPS, no fair CRPS); eligible only if sigma_M0 finite and > 0; uniqueness rule to be frozen after regularization.
audit_consequence: The division by sigma_M0 is part of the per-opportunity loss definition, not a weight. Origin weighting must not re-apply sigma-based weights or add pair weights based on sigma (that would be a different specification).
